verdict.rationale: The evidence pack is almost entirely first-party documentation: SDKs, the CLI, the MCP connector, the Vertex AI offering and the OpenAI-compat layer. None of it shows a community ecosystem of curated lists, third-party tools, routers or actively maintained integrations. Independent benchmark listings (Artificial Analysis, SWE-bench) show evaluation presence, not a living tool ecosystem. Community comments discuss model quality and pricing, not third-party tooling.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, the community ecosystem around the model is genuinely alive — curated lists, third-party tools, routers, and integrations with active maintainers
